integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: External services for game data, barcodes, play times, scores and covers. All optional – without them you enter games by hand.
integrations.adminOnly: Only admins can set them up.
integrations.unofficialText: No official API: it may stop working any time. Values already loaded stay.

local.title: Your own data
local.text: Confirmed barcodes, covers and play times are stored locally and reused for everyone – each source is asked only once.

about.igdb: Game data, regional release dates and covers for search. Free for non-commercial use (needs a Twitch account).
about.wikipedia: Titles, descriptions and first release in the interface's language (German or English) when matching. No key needed; texts are CC BY-SA, the source is saved with them. Only completes games you have, doesn't add any.
about.hltb: How long a game takes: main story, with extras, completionist. Shown on the game and as fields to sort and filter by.
about.opencritic: Critic scores (top critic average, percent recommended). Via RapidAPI, with a free tier.
about.thegamesdb: Front covers, also regional ones. Free API key with a monthly allowance.
about.screenscraper: Very good regional covers, especially for handhelds and retro. A user account is enough to start; developer credentials (requested from ScreenScraper) are optional.

edit.title: Set up {name}
edit.enabledText: Switched off, everything stored stays; only nothing new is fetched.
edit.accessText: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep them.
edit.freshnessText: When stored values count as outdated. Outdated values are fetched again when a game is opened.
edit.periodicText: Also fetches outdated values without anyone opening the game – gently, in small portions.

facts.title: Match: {source}
facts.description: Which entry on {source} belongs to this game? Your choice is kept.

covers.title: Find a cover
covers.description: Covers from TheGamesDB and ScreenScraper for this release. The one you choose is stored locally and shown for every copy of this release.
covers.descriptionCopy: Covers from TheGamesDB and ScreenScraper. The one you choose is only for this copy; the catalog stays as it is.
covers.none: No covers found. Try another search above, e.g. without the edition.
covers.noSources: No cover source set up. An admin can switch on TheGamesDB or ScreenScraper under “Integrations”.

metadata.title: Match game data
metadata.description: Which {source} entry is this game? Next you'll see what would change and decide yourself.
metadata.reviewHint: Empty fields and more precise dates are preselected. Anything that merely differs is only taken if you tick it.
metadata.apply: Link with entry | Apply 1 change | Apply {n} changes
metadata.applied: Nothing applied | 1 change applied | {n} changes applied

offers.igdb: Title, description (English), dates per platform, companies, genres, cover
offers.wikipedia: Title, description and first release in your language
